_readme: Portfolio content. Edit this file, push to main, and the site rebuilds itself on Vercel (scripts/build.mjs). Projects show in the order listed. Images live in /assets/work/<slug>/ (logo.webp = the client's logo, photo-*.webp = real-world photos).

projects.name: Alpha Vital Elite IV
projects.summary: A physician-directed IV therapy practice led by Dr. Violeta Aronov, DO, a board-certified anesthesiologist.
projects.brief: Dr. Aronov wanted a site that feels as calm and clinical as her treatment room, puts the physician review front and center, and screens patients for safety before anyone books.
built: An editorial home page with a clinic-tour video and a scroll-driven infusion menu
A page for every infusion: what's in it, how long it takes, the price, and its own FAQ
A free online eligibility screening — contact details first, then yes/no safety questions — sent to HIPAA-compliant Jotform
A 40-answer FAQ and a research page with published references
The doctor's story, press coverage and a guided tour of the clinic
Ongoing Instagram, Google Business Profile and marketing management

shots.caption: Step one of the free eligibility screening — pick an infusion

photos.caption: Front-desk display: Instagram and Google review QR codes, Dr. Aronov's portrait and a business card holder — designed and produced by us
The logo as a circle sign on the treatment-room door
The welcome banner in the waiting area

projects.name: Cohen & Associates
projects.summary: A boutique tax, accounting and advisory firm, founded in 2004, that represents clients before the IRS and state authorities in all 50 states.
projects.brief: Cohen & Associates wanted a site that matches the personal, boutique service clients get in their Rego Park office — and sends every inquiry straight to the team.
built: A six-page site: home, services, about, team, FAQ and contact
A hero video of the team and the office
Services organized into three pillars: tax strategy, financial management and business advisory
An industries section for dentists, attorneys, physicians, real estate, business owners and high-net-worth clients
A searchable FAQ with topic filters
A contact form with a service picker, delivered straight to the firm's inbox through Formspree

shots.caption: How working with the firm runs

photos.caption: The logo on the lobby wall

projects.name: Child & Family Psychological Services
projects.summary: Therapy, evaluations and family court services for children, teens, adults and families since 2007, led by Dr. Kristie Doheny, PsyD.
projects.brief: Parents often arrive worried and unsure what kind of help they need. The site had to feel warm, explain a long list of services in plain language, point people to the right office, and keep forensic referrals on their own line.
built: Eleven service guides, from child therapy to custody evaluations and neurofeedback
Clinician profiles with full bios
A tabbed FAQ across five topics, plus an insurance section
Four office cards — Hauppauge, Forest Hills, Patchogue and Mineola — with one-tap directions
A separate contact line for forensic and court-related referrals
A training institute section with the play-therapy workshop season and registration
Office and event structured data for local search

shots.caption: A tabbed FAQ across five topics

projects.name: Holistic Mental Health Services
projects.summary: Individual, couples and family therapy across four offices and telehealth statewide, founded by Dr. Kristie Doheny.
projects.brief: A sister practice to Child & Family with its own identity — calmer, focused on adults, and built around an $80 self-pay offer for daytime sessions.
built: An $80 self-pay offer with a live clock that shows whether today's booking window is open
Service guides for individual, couples and family therapy, CBT, EMDR, mindfulness, groups and neurofeedback
Therapy P.L.U.S., a dedicated LGBTQ+ affirming program
A founder profile and team directory
A filterable FAQ, crisis resources and four office cards with directions

shots.caption: The $80 offer, with a live booking-window clock

projects.name: Eviaesthetics
projects.summary: Dr. Evia A. Nano, MD's appointment-only aesthetics practice: injectables, skin treatments, medical weight management and IV therapy.
projects.brief: A private, by-appointment practice needs a site that feels discreet and high-end, yet still answers the two questions every new patient has: what does it cost, and how do I book?
built: A full treatment menu across ten categories, with published prices and pre- and post-care notes
Dedicated pages for IV therapy and hyperhidrosis treatment, each with its own FAQ
The physician's profile and the story of the practice
A consultation request form and click-to-call
A skincare section linked to the practice's AlumierMD shop

photos.caption: @eviaesthetics on Instagram — verified, with highlights for IV therapy, skin care, the clinic and testimonials
Google Business Profile: 5.0 stars from 86 Google reviews
Search results: eviaesthetics.com shows with sitelinks to its key pages

projects.name: Park City 3 & 4
projects.summary: A cooperative of six 14-story buildings in Rego Park, established in 1955 and managed by AKAM.
projects.brief: Replacing the co-op's old WordPress site with one place for everything residents need — forms, building rules, payments and amenities — that also shows off the grounds.
built: Nine online resident forms — alterations, garage waiting list, pet registration and more — delivered straight to management
Resident guides for ClickPay payments, moves and deliveries, insurance, house rules and sublets
Amenity pages for the pool, playground, garages, storage and laundry
A 48-photo gallery organized into buildings, interiors, amenities and grounds
A directory of all six buildings and a resident FAQ

projects.name: Laura's Beauty Touch
projects.summary: A Rego Park day spa for facials, laser hair removal, waxing, lashes, body treatments and nails, led by founder and master esthetician Laura.
projects.brief: With well over a hundred treatments across ten categories, the spa needed a site where clients can find the right service and its price quickly, then book or buy a gift card in a couple of taps.
built: A full treatment menu of about 134 priced services across ten category pages, loaded from easy-to-edit data files
Online booking and gift cards through Fresha
A payment-plan page for financing treatments through Cherry
A video hero that cycles through real treatments
Site-wide search, a beauty tips blog and a newsletter signup
Contact form and Google reviews badge

shots.caption: Home — a video hero of real treatments

projects.name: NYC Panache Salon
projects.summary: A luxury hair salon in Forest Hills for color, balayage, keratin smoothing, extensions, nails and waxing, led by founder and master stylist Marina Iskiyaeva.
projects.brief: Panache's work is visual, so the site had to show it — real transformations, a clear price list and booking one tap away — with the gold-and-cream polish of the salon itself.
built: A priced service menu for cuts, color, smoothing, extensions, nails and waxing
Drag-to-compare before-and-after sliders and a filterable gallery
Online booking through Vagaro
A cinematic video hero
An FAQ page, Instagram feed and contact form
An llms.txt file so AI search tools describe the salon accurately

projects.name: Doug Uhlig Psychological Services
projects.summary: Dr. Doug Uhlig, PhD runs two practices from one site: evidence-based therapy across three NYC offices, and the Manhattan Executive Coaching Consortium (MECC).
projects.brief: Two audiences — people looking for a therapist and leaders looking for a coach — had to land on one site and each find their path in a single click.
built: A split home page that sends visitors to therapy or executive coaching
A four-part leadership intake quiz for coaching clients
A directory of the full clinical team, plus coach profiles
Location cards for the Manhattan, Brooklyn and Rego Park offices with directions
Services, team, coaching and contact pages
Contact forms and a link to his Psychology Today profile

shots.caption: Home — therapy or executive coaching, one click
The Manhattan Executive Coaching Consortium page

projects.name: Century One Management
projects.summary: A property management company on Queens Boulevard in Rego Park managing residential, commercial and luxury properties across Queens and NYC, led by founder and CEO Zarina Yusupova.
projects.brief: Owners need to trust a manager before they hand over a building. The site had to explain the service plainly, show the portfolio and turn ad traffic into consultation requests.
built: Service pages for residential, commercial and luxury management
A properties page with filters, sorting and detail views
Tenant and owner portal links through DoorLoop
A dedicated ad landing page with a lead form
A how-it-works process, areas served and FAQ

projects.name: East Coast Realty by Zarina
projects.summary: A New York real estate brokerage led by founder and principal broker Zarina Yusupova, with listings, buyer tools and local guidance.
projects.brief: Renters and buyers want to browse listings and run the numbers before they call. The site puts both front and center.
built: Rental listings with search filters and map views
A mortgage calculator, debt-to-income calculator and home value estimator
An IDX link for browsing all listings
FAQ and Fair Housing notice
Reviews and a contact form

projects.name: Iconic Aesthetics
projects.summary: A Rego Park studio for permanent makeup, lashes, brows and facials, led by founder and lead aesthetician Ilanit Shalom.
projects.brief: Permanent makeup is a big decision. The site leads with real before-and-after results and clear prices so clients arrive confident.
built: A menu of 18 services with prices and durations
A before-and-after gallery of real results
An FAQ for first-time clients
A booking request form
An Instagram feed and refund policy page

projects.name: Barber World
projects.summary: An online store for professional barber clippers, trimmers and shavers from BaBylissPRO, StyleCraft, JRL and more.
projects.brief: A custom store that takes payment, calculates tax and ships orders without a monthly platform fee — and gets the shipping label printed automatically.
built: A catalog of about 70 professional products across brand and category pages, with filters and sorting
Checkout through Stripe with cards, Klarna and Afterpay, plus automatic sales tax
Serverless order handling that buys the Shippo shipping label the moment an order is paid
Order confirmation and store policy pages
An AI chat assistant for product questions
